schema_language: JSON Schema (subset: object, array, string, number, boolean)
call_shape: jsonformer = Jsonformer(model, tokenizer, json_schema, prompt); generated_data = jsonformer()
providers: single (local HuggingFace transformers models only; needs raw logits access)
license: MIT (stated in README; no LICENSE file present in the repo)
notable: Only value tokens are sampled; braces, quotes and keys are written by the driver

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel
call_shape: user = client.chat.completions.create(response_model=User, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "John is 25 years old"}])
providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google/Gemini, Vertex AI, Mistral, Cohere, Groq, Ollama, Bedrock, Fireworks, Cerebras, Writer, xAI, Perplexity, OpenRouter
notable: Patches the provider's own SDK client, so create() keeps its native signature plus response_model

schema_language: custom DSL (.baml class/enum), codegen to Pydantic/TS types
call_shape: from baml_client import b; resume = b.ExtractResume(resume_text)
providers: OpenAI, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic, Google AI/Gemini, Vertex, AWS Bedrock, Azure, OpenRouter, openai-generic (Groq, Ollama, LM Studio, Cerebras, LiteLLM, HuggingFace)
notable: Schema-Aligned Parsing coerces malformed LLM text into the schema instead of using provider structured outputs

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel, plus primitives and generics (list[Book], dict[str,str], Enum, Literal) via format=
call_shape: @llm.call("anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5", format=Book) -> book = recommend_book("fantasy").parse()
providers: openai, anthropic, google, mlx/local, plus openai-compatible endpoints
notable: Formatting mode is pluggable per call: strict, tool, json, or custom parser; defaults to strict.

schema_language: python type annotations - pydantic BaseModel, TypedDict, Enum, Literal, builtins (Task result_type)
call_shape: result = marvin.extract("i found $30 on the ground and bought 5 bagels for $10", int, instructions="only USD")
providers: openai (default), anthropic, google, groq, mistral, bedrock, cohere, ollama - any Pydantic AI model
notable: Every extraction is an agent task; result arrives as a forced MarkTaskSuccessful end-turn tool call.

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel (optional; omitted means free-form JSON dict)
call_shape: SmartScraperGraph(prompt="List me all the projects with their description", source="https://perinim.github.io/projects/", schema=Projects, config=graph_config).run()
providers: OpenAI, Azure, Groq, Gemini, Mistral, Bedrock, Ollama, NVIDIA (via LangChain)
notable: Chunk-parallel-merge graph pipeline; schema enforced by prompt instructions on OpenAI but native JSON-schema decoding on Ollama.

schema_language: none - fixed Element taxonomy (Title, NarrativeText, Table, ...), no user-supplied schema
call_shape: elements = partition(filename="example-docs/eml/fake-email.eml")
providers: none (no LLM provider in the OSS core)
notable: No schema input at all: deterministic per-format parsers plus a layout detection model emit fixed element types

schema_language: none formal — per-field natural-language prompts authored in Prompt Studio, each tagged with an EnforceType (text/number/email/date/boolean/json/line-item/table) defined in backend/prompt_studio/prompt_studio_v2/models.py
call_shape: curl --request POST --location '<host>/deployment/api/<org>/<api_name>/' --header 'Authorization: Bearer REPLACE_WITH_API_KEY' --form 'files=@"/path/to/file"' --form 'timeout=300' --form 'include_metadata=false'
providers: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, Ollama, Mistral, Anyscale (routed through LiteLLM)
notable: Schema lives server-side in Prompt Studio; the API call ships only the document

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel class or instance; also plain dict or JSON-ish string template
call_shape: result = extractor.extract(source=file_path, template=Invoice)
providers: single (local HF transformers VLM: numind/NuExtract-2.0-2B default, ibm-granite/granite-vision-4.1-4b alt)
notable: Pydantic template is rendered by polyfactory into a filled example JSON, then prompted to the VLM

schema_language: Python types + pydantic BaseModel; also JSON Schema, regex, Lark CFG, function signatures
call_shape: ticket = model(prompt, ServiceTicket, max_new_tokens=500)
providers: transformers, llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, MLX, LM Studio, TGI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Dottxt
notable: Identical model(prompt, output_type) call on every backend; enforcement silently swaps between logit masking and provider response_format

schema_language: custom DSL: `where` constraint expressions (INT, REGEX, STOPS_AT, `in set([...])`, len(TOKENS(V))); dataclasses via lmql.lib.types
call_shape: lmql.F("Say 'this is a test': [RESPONSE]", "len(TOKENS(RESPONSE)) < 10")
providers: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, HuggingFace Transformers, llama.cpp, Replicate
notable: Constraints compile to eager token masks; `distribution` clause yields P(VAR) over enumerated candidate values

schema_language: Kor Object/Text/Number/Bool/Selection nodes (pydantic-typed); pydantic BaseModel via from_pydantic
call_shape: create_extraction_chain(llm, schema, encoder_or_encoder_class='json').invoke("play songs by paul simon and led zeppelin and the doors")['data']
providers: any LangChain BaseLanguageModel (OpenAI, Anthropic, local, etc.)
notable: Swappable output encoder (CSV/JSON/XML); returns errors beside partial data instead of retrying the model

schema_language: few-shot lx.data.ExampleData/Extraction dataclasses (schema inferred from examples); optional JSON Schema via output_schema
call_shape: result = lx.extract(text_or_documents=input_text, prompt_description=prompt, examples=examples, model_id="gemini-3.5-flash")
providers: Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, plus pluggable custom/community providers
notable: Every extracted value is fuzzy-aligned back to exact source char offsets; unalignable ones get char_interval=None

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel (also JSON Schema, or RAIL XML spec via for_rail)
call_shape: guard = Guard.for_pydantic(output_class=Orders); res = guard(model="gpt-5", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}])
providers: LiteLLM (100+ models), OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace pipelines/models, Manifest, arbitrary callable
notable: Hub validators attach per field; on failure it reasks only the bad values, not the whole schema.

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel / JSON Schema for gen_json; regex and composable CFG via @guidance(stateless=True) functions
call_shape: from guidance import json as gen_json; lm += gen_json(name="bp", schema=BloodPressure)
providers: Transformers, llama.cpp, OpenAI, Azure AI, ONNX Runtime GenAI, Mock
notable: Grammar is interleaved with the prompt, and tokens the grammar already determines are fast-forwarded, skipping forward passes

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel or any pydantic-supported Python type, declared as the function's return annotation
call_shape: @prompt("Create a Superhero named {name}.") / def create_superhero(name: str) -> Superhero: ... / create_superhero("Garden Man")
providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, LiteLLM (100+); OpenAI-compatible: Ollama, Gemini, xAI, Mistral, OpenRouter
notable: No extract() call exists; the schema IS the decorated stub's return annotation, and structured output can stream.

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel, dataclass, or plain Python types (bool/int/float/str, Literal, Enum, list[T], datetime), optionally Annotated[T, "desc"]
call_shape: model = Models.create("llamacpp:openchat"); model.extract(Info, "Who was the first man in the moon?")
providers: local llama.cpp/GGUF, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, Fireworks, Together
notable: Ships its own JSON-Schema-to-GBNF converter, so local models are grammar-constrained rather than prompt-coaxed.

schema_language: JSON-by-example DSL — a sample JSON whose values are type tokens ("str", 0, 0.0, "str or null"), compiled into a real JSON Schema by JSONValidator and checked with jsonschema.validate
call_shape: ./sparrow.sh '[{"instrument_name":"str", "valuation":0}]' --pipeline "sparrow-parse" --options mlx --options mlx-community/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct-4bit --file-path "data/bonds_table.png"
providers: MLX, Ollama, vLLM, Hugging Face Spaces, local GPU, Mistral OCR cloud — all self-hosted VLMs except Mistral
license: GPL-3.0 (dual-licensed; commercial license required above $5M revenue)
notable: Schema is a JSON example with type tokens; validation is post-hoc, reported as a valid field

schema_language: TypeScript interface source (also Zod via typechat/zod; Python port uses TypedDict/dataclass/pydantic)
call_shape: const response = await createJsonTranslator(model, createTypeScriptJsonValidator<SentimentResponse>(schema, "SentimentResponse")).translate(request);
providers: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI; any other via custom TypeChatLanguageModel
notable: Schema is TypeScript source in the prompt; the TypeScript compiler validates the reply, one repair turn fixes it

schema_language: zod (or JSON Schema), wrapped in AI SDK Output.object
call_shape: const { data } = await scraper.run(page, Output.object({ schema }), { format: 'raw_html' })
providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, Ollama (any Vercel AI SDK provider)
notable: Thin wrapper over Vercel AI SDK; six input formats including screenshots, plus Playwright code-generation mode.

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel or JSON Schema string; also EBNF, Lark, and structural tags
call_shape: compiled = xgr.GrammarCompiler(tokenizer_info).compile_json_schema(Person); model.generate(**model_inputs, logits_processor=[xgr.contrib.hf.LogitsProcessor(compiled)])
providers: HF transformers, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, MLC-LLM, OpenVINO GenAI, Modular MAX, WebLLM
notable: CPU bitmask generation overlaps the GPU forward pass, so masking adds near-zero decode latency

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel (.schema()) or JSON Schema dict; also regex strings
call_shape: hf_pipeline(prompt, prefix_allowed_tokens_fn=build_transformers_prefix_allowed_tokens_fn(hf_pipeline.tokenizer, JsonSchemaParser(AnswerFormat.schema())))
providers: HF transformers, vLLM, llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, TensorRT-LLM, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack
notable: Allows any token sequence that parses, so the model keeps control of whitespace and field order

schema_language: pydantic BaseModel (also dataclasses, TypedDict, StructuredDict, scalars, unions/lists of types)
call_shape: agent = Agent('google:gemini-3-flash-preview', output_type=CityLocation); result = agent.run_sync('Where were the olympics held in 2012?')
providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, Mistral, Cohere, DeepSeek, Bedrock, Ollama, HuggingFace, LiteLLM, 25+
notable: Three selectable output modes - tool call (default), native JSON schema, prompted - picked per type via marker classes.

schema_language: Pydantic v2 declarative concept classes (StringConcept, JsonObjectConcept, BooleanConcept, RatingConcept, LabelConcept...)
call_shape: doc = Document(raw_text="..."); doc.concepts = [StringConcept(name="Anomalies", description="Anomalies in the document", add_references=True, reference_depth="sentences")]; doc = llm.extract_all(doc)
providers: LiteLLM-backed: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, Ollama, LM Studio, etc.
notable: You never write a prompt or schema; natural-language concept descriptions generate prompts, references, and justifications
